$comment: Centralized V1 3D-scene complexity/payload limits, mirroring schema/limits.json's role for the 2D schema (see issue #210). #211's Python/TypeScript validators are expected to load this file and enforce it identically after schema/scene3d.schema.json structural validation passes. Per-field numeric ranges (opacity, fov, dimensions, etc.) live in scene3d.schema.json itself; this file governs scene-wide counts and total payload size, which plain JSON Schema cannot express -- see schema/README3d.md's 'Fixtures and the schema/validator split' section.
$noGroupNestingComment: V1 group3d has no childIds/parentGroupId -- groups are flat (only objects reference a group, via their own groupId), so there is no group-of-groups nesting to cap, unlike the 2D schema's maxGroupNestingDepth.
